slots.image_prompt: Minimalist abstract cover background for an open-source technology reading presentation. Expansive pale off-white space (#F5F5F5) with thin Klein Blue (#002FA7) geometric line elements flowing diagonally from the upper right, suggesting digital connectivity and open information flow. A few subtle intersecting curves and sparse circular dots arranged asymmetrically on the right third of the frame. Ultra-clean gallery-like composition with generous negative space, editorial magazine aesthetic. No text, no logos, no people. Light and airy, calm blue accent against bright neutral background.

Minimalist section divider background. A bold Klein Blue (#002FA7) vertical color block occupies the left fifth of the frame, set against expansive warm off-white space (#F5F5F5). A single thin horizontal accent line in coral (#FF7043) crosses the boundary where the blue block meets the white area. Subtle geometric corner mark in the upper right. Clean editorial magazine-style composition with dramatic contrast between solid color and negative space. No text, no imagery of people or objects. Ultra-minimal sophisticated layout, gallery quality.

Abstract minimalist visual representing four interconnected content pillars arranged in a balanced 2x2 grid composition. Four softly rounded square forms in Klein Blue (#002FA7) gradient tones, slightly elevated with subtle drop shadows on a pale gray background (#F5F5F5). Thin connecting lines in coral (#FF7043) cross between the quadrants forming a delicate internal framework. Each square contains a simple geometric icon silhouette in white negative space — a document shape, a chat bubble, a news broadcast symbol, and a share node. Clean flat design, symmetrical balance, editorial infographic aesthetic. No legible text.

Minimalist three-stage progressive pathway visual. Three horizontal rectangular gradient bands in Klein Blue (#002FA7) arranged left to right, each progressively wider to symbolize growth and expansion. The first band is narrow and light blue, the second medium width and mid-tone blue, the third broad and deep saturated blue. Each band floats slightly above a pale gray surface (#F5F5F5) with a soft shadow beneath. A subtle coral (#FF7043) arrow accent connects the bands at their junctions. Clean airy composition with generous white space above and below. Abstract metaphor of a learning journey. No text, no labels.

Minimalist chapter identifier visual featuring a large abstract geometric form suggesting the numeral zero-one, rendered in deep Klein Blue (#002FA7) as a bold solid shape occupying the left side of the frame. The right side features sparse decorative geometric elements: thin concentric arcs, a few scattered dots, and a single coral (#FF7043) accent line. The entire composition sits on a clean pale off-white background (#F5F5F5) with abundant negative space. Editorial refined aesthetic, gallery quality. No legible text or characters.

Abstract minimalist visual representing three governance pillars as three vertical columns of soft geometric forms. Each column is topped by a perfect circle in Klein Blue (#002FA7), descending into elongated rounded rectangles that taper downward on a pale gray background (#F5F5F5). The three circles are connected by a delicate horizontal line in coral (#FF7043), symbolizing interconnected governance elements. Symmetrical balanced composition with calm negative space. Clean flat design with subtle depth, editorial magazine quality. No text, no icons with labels.

Minimalist reflective quote card visual with a large ornamental opening quotation mark rendered in Klein Blue (#002FA7) in the upper left, paired with a subtle mirrored closing quote mark in the lower right in soft coral (#FF7043). The center features a clean rectangular panel with a thin blue border suggesting a blank quote card, floating on a pale off-white background (#F5F5F5). Delicate geometric linework frames the composition with airy negative space. Serene contemplative editorial aesthetic, gallery quality. No text.

Minimalist closing visual with a large Klein Blue (#002FA7) circular form centered slightly off-center on an expansive pale gray background (#F5F5F5). Concentric thin blue rings radiate outward from the central circle, suggesting waves of influence and community growth spreading outward. A single coral (#FF7043) dot accent sits near the upper right, representing a spark or seed of open-source spirit. Generous negative space, calm and hopeful atmosphere. Abstract metaphor of openness and ripple effect. No text, no logos.
